excluded_from_publication: BF16 source weights and the quantized container
panel scripts and captured activation sets
raw run receipts, local paths, and host identity

metrics.weight_rel_rms: sqrt(mean((reconstruction - W_bf16)^2)) / sqrt(mean(W_bf16^2)); unweighted mean over (layer, expert, role) slices
metrics.activation_error: Frobenius ||teacher - candidate|| / ||teacher|| on captured routed-MoE inputs; gate and up consume the captured hidden, down consumes silu(gate(x)) * up(x)
metrics.activation_source: 2048-token calibration pass over all 48 layers at the routed-expert input, plus a 512-token holdout pass, CPU executor, captured 2026-09-16
metrics.not_a_capability_metric: teacher-KL for these candidates is BLOCKED_NOT_CAPTURED; fidelity is not capability

byte_basis.note: a single receipt recorded a per-role T1 payload as 1433600 B; that is a float32 byte-count unit error and the correct value is 358400 B

bases.name: LS-reencoded T1, identical bytes
bases.note: least-squares group scale at the same container size as raw T1

bases.name: Q2_0 donor scaffold (block 64)
bases.note: decoded from the real container bytes, not a same-rate re-encode; a fresh Q2_0 re-encode of the same BF16 source measures 0.723464018510421 weight relRMS

dense_t1_t2.note: the panel stores activation gains per candidate but no mean weight relRMS per candidate, so the 0.4376 value is a per-slice measurement and must not be quoted as a panel mean

equal_added_byte_panel.byte_charge_basis: format-only payload, identical for every base

over_t1_base.format: LS-scale ternary re-encode at identical bytes

conclusions: the 2-bit residual codebook removed roughly 2.3x more activation error than dense ternary T2 for the same added bytes over the donor base
rotation contributed almost nothing on top of the 2-bit codebook
at equal bytes over T1, LS-scale re-encoding beat the dense ternary T2 plane

residual_island.format: q8_0 additive residual plane over a T1 base
residual_island.disposition: mechanism evidence that optional high-fidelity corrective payloads work; explicitly not the final representation, because a stronger base codec reaches better fidelity for far fewer bytes

defects_recorded: one receipt recorded a per-role T1 payload as 1433600 B (a float32 byte-count unit error); the correct payload is 358400 B
an earlier prose summary printed the donor's activation error (~0.444) in a weight relRMS column; the donor's weight relRMS is ~0.459 (27 slices) or ~0.488 (panel)
not_measured: end-to-end quality of the final bank
